text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock B and C after gains may feel satisfying, but trimming should reflect valuation, portfolio balance, and the thesis—not just a desire to lock in profits.","Selling Stock D at substantial losses was painful; I should define risk limits in advance and reassess the thesis consistently rather than letting loss aversion drive the timing.","I should judge decisions by their rationale and longer-term results, not by short-term account swings or whether a trade happened to be profitable."]}
